status: CP-AB DISPATCHED — npm test works EXACTLY ONCE per database. Found by doing what a real user does: running it twice. Run 1 on an empty DB is 1102/0 GREEN exit 0; run 2 on the SAME database is FATAL: migrate.sql failed to apply: relation contacts already exists, exit 2; run 3 identical, so deterministic not a race. Cause: migrate.sql is not idempotent (4 bare CREATE TABLE, 0 with IF NOT EXISTS), which never mattered because the Docker path spins a FRESH container per run — CP-AA correctly made DATABASE_URL_TEST the path everyone without Docker uses, and that database PERSISTS. So a new contributors first npm test is green and their second is FATAL, and they will conclude the suite is broken. Fix: DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE + CREATE SCHEMA public inside test/apply-schema.mjs, guarded by the non-local check already duplicated there — explicitly NOT by sprinkling IF NOT EXISTS through migrate.sql, which would let a PARTIALLY applied schema pass as complete and which is the production base schema, not a test fixture. AB3 requires proving the DROP is UNREACHABLE for a non-local URL, and AB5 requires AA4 still holding so a reset path cannot swallow failures. Also cleaned three stray processes of my own this tick (cpi-shim :8903, orch-twilio-stub :8901, orch-resend-stub :8899 — the last was what had been contending for 8899 earlier).
